title: Universal property of the evaluated scalar-extended root tower
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell, a scheme T, Chern data c [def-sp-tower-class-chern], and a positive-exponent index n. Evaluation at n of the ordinary coefficient extension of c.rootModule represents the functor taking an A_n-module N to additive sheaf morphisms from the actual ell^(n+1)-roots sheaf to the underlying additive sheaf of N. The representing Hom equivalences are natural for postcomposition, and take a morphism f to a root map q such that f(a times the scalar-extension generator x) = a times q(rootForget(x)). The equation is interpreted using the section identifications of the recorded Forget functor.

proof.text: Every additive map between Rlevel-module sheaves is Rlevel-linear: the constant CommRingCat sheafification unit is locally surjective, so test scalar-linearity after lifting a scalar locally to ULift(ZMod(ell^(n+1))). Lift it further to an integer. The scalar-linearity equation then follows from preservation of integer multiples. Separatedness of the target sheaf descends the equality. The resulting inverse to forgetting morphisms gives Hom equivalences without choosing or changing either module action.

proof.text: Apply forget_evaluation_iso with G equal to the roots tower and h equal to c.rootForget. This yields an isomorphism e from the roots sheaf at n to the additive evaluated root module, whose section equation is e(rootForget(x prime)) = x for HEq representatives. Precompose additive morphisms with e and combine with the coefficient-linear Hom equivalence. Functoriality proves postcomposition naturality. For the scalar formula, apply the general scalar-extension formula, then apply the function x maps to a times Psi(f)(x) to the inverse of the section equation of e.

theorem towerLineEvaluation_universal (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    {T : Scheme.{u}} (c : Chern l E T) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ Φ : ∀ N : SemilinearSections.Mod.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (SpTowerShriek.B l E T n),
      (((SpTowerShriek.ev l E T n).obj (lineModule l E c)) ⟶ N) ≃
        ((roots l T).obj (op n) ⟶ (SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj N),
      (∀ {N N'} (f : (SpTowerShriek.ev l E T n).obj (lineModule l E c) ⟶ N)
        (g : N ⟶ N'),
        Φ N' (f ≫ g) = Φ N f ≫ (SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).map g) ∧
      (∀ N (f : (SpTowerShriek.ev l E T n).obj (lineModule l E c) ⟶ N)
        (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) (a : (SpTowerShriek.B l E T n).obj.obj U)
        (x : c.rootModule.val.obj (op (n, U.unop)))
        (x' : ((c.reduction.forget.F.obj c.rootModule).obj (op n)).obj.obj U)
        (v : ((SpTowerShriek.ev l E T n).obj (lineModule l E c)).val.obj U),
        HEq x x' →
        HEq v (a • SemilinearSections.scalarExtensionSection.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
          (coefficientSystemMap l E T) c.scalar c.rootModule (op (n, U.unop)) x) →
        f.val.app U v = a • (show N.val.obj U from (Φ N f).hom.app U
          (((c.rootForget.hom.app (op n)).hom.app U) x')))
